mechanism: Both drugs possess anticholinergic properties that additively suppress parasympathetic activity, and perphenazine inhibits CYP2D6 which metabolizes tolterodine, increasing tolterodine exposure.
action: Monitor for enhanced anticholinergic effects (urinary retention, constipation, dry mouth, cognitive/vision changes); consider dose reduction of tolterodine or alternative antipsychotic with lower anticholinergic burden.
